summary: LandBridge Co LLC subsidiary DBR Land Holdings LLC closed an upsized private placement of $125M additional 6.250% Senior Notes due 2030, boosting the initial $100M offering. The New Notes are fungible with $500M of existing notes of the same series, rank as senior unsecured obligations, and are guaranteed jointly and severally by all existing subsidiaries. Proceeds repay revolving credit facility borrowings. Notes were placed under Rule 144A and Regulation S. This is a routine debt financing, not a special situation; watch for leverage, redemption mechanics, and any follow-on M&A or asset activity.
